notes: Prices are KES. No categories array (only BRANDS_DATA, BEAUTY_GUIDES). No featured flag; isNew exists. Has sizes[] with per-size price.

Use PRODUCTS, not RAW_CATALOG (RAW_CATALOG is positional tuples; PRODUCTS is built from it). Base currency USD; priceNGN/compareNGN also exist (no KES). image is images[0] (generated by buildStudioImage). Category id is CATEGORIES[].slug, not id.

Categories are a hardcoded string list inside the render function (starts with 'all'), not a named array. category is the display name e.g. 'Engine Parts'. Extra: oemCode, condition, stock, compatibility[], specs{}.
No categories array; category/subcategory/audience live on each product. Extra: galleryImages[], colors[{name,hex}], sizes[], material, fit, sku, badge.

PRODUCTS is built at runtime from MODEL_BLUEPRINTS + EXTRA_VARIANTS (blueprints use cat/orig/desc; PRODUCTS uses category/origPrice/desc). CATEGORIES_LIST is plain strings. No featured/bestseller flag; use tag, isNew, isSale. Extra: sizes[], stockBySize{}, colors[].

CATALOG_PRODUCTS = PRODUCT_BLUEPRINTS plus generated rows. price is retail; trade is the bulk/contractor price (lower than retail, so not a compare-at). id is sku. category is the dept code (A, B...), match to MASTER_DEPARTMENTS[].code. Sub-category in 'sub'. No description field (specs{} and synonyms only).
reviews field is reviewCount (singular). Extra: fallbackImage, features[], specs{}, boxContents, warranty, variants, inStock, stockCount. File is 4.4 MB because images are embedded.

price is an object {EUR,USD,GBP,NGN}; there is no KES. sizeMultipliers scales it per size. category choices: family (Woody...), collection, concentration. isLimited is the closest thing to featured. Extra: topNotes/heartNotes/baseNotes, longevity, sillage, ritual, secondaryImage.

Reviews field is reviewCount. No bestseller flag (isNew exists). Prices look USD-scale (e.g. 1199). Category name field is 'name' (also 'short'). Extra: subCategory, colors[], variants[], gallery[], specs{}, inStock.

No categories array; categories are the product.category and product.room values (sofas, living...). ROOM_COMBOS is a bundle list (id, code, title, price, originalPrice, image), not categories. Extra: sku, features[], dimensions{}, materials, finish, colors[], stock, inStock, tags.

PRODUCTS is generated (MODELS x VARIANTS). price is the base/list price and salePrice is the discounted one, so the displayed price is salePrice ?? price, and compare-at = price when salePrice is set. There is no image field (imageCount: 4, images are generated). CATEGORIES id key is slug. Extra: shortName, slug, sku, discount, deal, newProduct, specs{}, features[].

Data is a JSON literal assigned to window.AUREX_PRODUCTS (104 items). Categories are an inline object list inside a render function (id, name, count, icon), no named array. bestseller: none, use 'badge' or 'deal'. Extra: brand, gallery[], specs{}, variants.

category holds the CATEGORIES_DATA id (seeds, etc). No compare price, featured or bestseller. Extra: packSize, stock (string), inStock, isRestricted, restrictionNote, isQuotationOnly, activeIngredient, dosage, preHarvestInterval, crops[].

Compiled Vite/React bundle, so there is no readable named array (data is inside the minified JS). Field names are real, taken from the records. category is the sub-category ('Fresh Vegetables'); department is the top level and matches the categories' id/slug. featured candidates: isTrending, isFreshPick, isDeal. Reviews field is reviewCount. Extra: slug, brand, unit, stockCount, inStock, isNewArrival, isBakeryFavorite.

Folder 'index'. PRODUCTS is filled in buildDatabase() from seed arrays. snake_case fields. price is the regular price and sale_price the discounted one. Categories come from CATEGORY_SEED (positional rows: slug, name, parent, description, intro, buying_guide, image, sort, department), not a keyed array. Extra: sku, subcategory, unit, review_count, badge, dietary[], organic.

Folder 'shop'. PRODUCTS is built from positional PRODUCT_SEED rows. price is the regular price, salePrice the discounted one. Short field names: img, cat, sub, desc. reviews field is reviewCount. This file also holds services, designs, packages, memberships, etc.
Retail products are SHOP_PRODUCTS; the booking catalogue is SERVICES_DATA (see the blush-nailtech-services entry). Extra: sku, stockStatus, maxQty, variants.
Services list for the same theme. priceType says fixed vs from. Extra: code, categorySlug, durationMins, depositRequired, includedWork.
Salon theme. Also PACKAGES (id, title, price, duration, image, description, inclusions) and STYLISTS. Extra: duration, inclusions, prep, aftercare, recommendedStylist. No categories array.

Safari packages. Also priceUSD. Packages have no 'category' field, so travelStyle / comfortTier are the closest. SAFARI_CATEGORIES is {id,title,desc,icon} and is not linked by id. DESTINATIONS is a separate array (id, name, region, image, description). Extra: duration, daysCount, itinerary[], inclusions[], exclusions[].
Restaurant menu. CATEGORIES is {id,label,icon} (label, not name). COMBOS_DATABASE is a separate bundle list. Extra: prepTime, isHalal, isSpicy, isHealthy.

Listings. image is images[0]. fullDesc is the long description. rentPeriod is set for rentals; purpose is sale vs rent. Other arrays: AGENTS_DATA, NEIGHBOURHOODS_DATA. Extra: beds, baths, sqm, lat, lng, agentId, amenities[].

Short-stay rentals. price is per night; cleaningFee, serviceFeePercent, taxPercent are separate. image is heroImg, with gallery[]. Extra: destination, guests, bedrooms, beds, baths, amenities[], bookedDates[].

Not a flat array: AURELIA_LOCATIONS is an object keyed by location (cotedazur, ...), each with its own currency (EUR for cotedazur) and a rooms[] list. Room: id, name, size, price, image, features[]. Location holds name, region, description, heroImg, restaurantName, chef.
Nested object, not a top-level array. price is a display string ('KES 450,000 / $3,500'), not a number. Also APP_DATA.portfolio and APP_DATA.packages. Extra: tagline, icon, scope[], timeline.

Hospitality theme in a compiled Vite bundle (no named arrays). Stay packages: id, name, description, priceUSD, priceKES, inclusions[]. Dining items: id, name, description, priceKES, priceUSD, dietary[], pairing. priceUSD is also available; there is no compare-at price or image field in these records.
Only a gallery array was found (id, category, title, img). The menu data is not in a readable top-level array in this file, so there is nothing to map for dishes yet.
No data arrays or prices found; static HTML only.
